Economics BSc at University of Manchester

What University of Manchester asks of applicants to Economics BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Manchester courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 5 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma from an accredited US school: Manchester typically requires the equivalent of three A-levels plus GCSE English and Mathematics/Science
  • SAT I 1290 or ACT 27 is listed as one way to meet the GCSE-equivalent part (alternatively the High School Diploma with a minimum 3.0 and grade 12 classes at the GCSE grade equivalent)
  • SAT/ACT is not listed as meeting the A-level part — that is met with three AP tests or dual-enrolment/college-level classes in separate subjects, plus the High School Diploma (GPA 3.0)

University-wide guidance on Manchester’s page for students from the US (undated, current); it is not specific to this course.

Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Information for students from the US
English language
  • IELTS: 6.5 overall, no component below 6 (in-person tests at official centres only)
  • TOEFL iBT: 90 overall, minimum 20 in each section
  • GCSE/iGCSE English Language grade C, or iGCSE English (Second Language) grade B
Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: BSc Economics (2027 entry)

None listed on the official source

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement (USA High School Diploma applicants): three APs at 5,5,5 including AP Calculus BC at 5 for BSc Economics
  • Plus the USA High School Diploma with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0, including grade B in English Language and Mathematics

Chain: the BSc Economics 2027-entry course page (typical offer AAA including Mathematics) links to the School of Social Sciences’ country-specific pages, whose USA entry at the AAA level names BSc Economics. The School page calls its requirements a minimum guide that may vary by applicant and course; it is undated.

Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester School of Social Sciences: Country-specific information — Americas · Manchester: BSc Economics (2027 entry)
Other requirements
